# AI tools

The AI chat works with tools. This page lists every tool the model can call, its arguments and its **gate**: what happens before the tool runs.

- **auto**: runs at once. It only reads, or it only changes the view.
- **confirm (class)**: termocode asks you first. In the dialog, **Always allow** stops the questions for this class (`fileWrite`, `git`, `run`, `ide`, `settings`). Change it later with **AI: Agent Auto-Approve…**.
- **confirm (always asks)**: termocode asks every time, with no **Always allow**. These calls can lose data.
- **never**: the AI can not do it. The model gets the reason.

Some tools have an `op` argument; then each op has its own gate.

## Tools

### read_file

Read a file and return its contents.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | file path, relative to the workspace |

### list_dir

List the entries of a directory.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |   | directory, relative to the workspace (default: root) |

### search

Search the workspace for a literal text pattern (max 50 matches).

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes | text to find |

### git_status

Show the working-tree status (changed / staged files).

**Gate:** auto

No arguments.

### git_diff

Show the diff of one file vs HEAD, or of all changes when path is empty.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |   | file path (optional) |

### git_branch

List git branches (current marked with *).

**Gate:** auto

No arguments.

### write_file

Write a file with new content (creates it if missing). If the file is open in the editor, its tab shows the new text (the user can undo it); a file with unsaved edits in the editor is refused. The user reviews the change as a diff and accepts or rejects each part; the result says what was written.

**Gate:** confirm (review)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | string | yes | the complete new file content |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |

### create_file

Create a new file, optionally with content. Fails if it exists. The user reviews the change as a diff and accepts or rejects each part; the result says what was written.

**Gate:** confirm (review)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |
| `content` | string |   | initial content (optional) |

### create_dir

Create a directory (and missing parents).

**Gate:** confirm (fileWrite)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | directory path |

### delete

Delete a file or directory. Its editor tabs are closed; a file with unsaved edits in the editor is refused.

**Gate:** confirm (fileWrite)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | path to delete |

### rename

Rename or move a file / directory. Open editor tabs follow to the new name (unsaved edits are kept). Fails if the target exists.

**Gate:** confirm (fileWrite)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | yes | current path |
| `to` | string | yes | new path |

Stage a file for the next commit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |

Commit the staged changes with a message.

**Gate:** confirm (git)

| `message` | string | yes | commit message |

Switch to a branch, optionally creating it.

**Gate:** confirm (git)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branch` | string | yes | branch name |
| `create` | boolean |   | create the branch first |

Push the current branch to its remote.

**Gate:** confirm (git)

No arguments.

### git_pull

Pull the current branch from its remote.

**Gate:** confirm (git)

No arguments.

### run_command

Run a shell command HIDDEN in the workspace root and return its captured output (one-shot: build, test, grep, …; 2 min limit). For a command the user wants to see, an interactive one or a long-running one (dev server, watcher), use terminal_send instead.

**Gate:** confirm (run)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string | yes | shell command |

### lsp_nav

Go to definition, type definition, implementations or references of the symbol at a file position, via the language server.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | integer | yes | 1-based column |
| `line` | integer | yes | 1-based line |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |
| `kind` | string |   | One of: `definition`, `type_definition`, `implementation`, `references` |

### diagnostics

List language-server diagnostics (errors / warnings) for a file, or for all open files when path is empty.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |   | file path (optional) |

### format

Format a file with its language server. The user reviews the change as a diff; accepted parts are saved.

**Gate:** confirm (review)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |

### open_file

Open a file in the user's editor (as the active tab), optionally at a line and column, and reveal it in the explorer.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |
| `column` | integer |   | 1-based column (optional) |
| `line` | integer |   | 1-based line (optional) |

### get_editor_state

Read the editor state: active file, cursor, selection, visible lines, open tabs, unsaved files and focus.

**Gate:** auto

No arguments.

### notify

Show the user a short notification (toast) in the IDE.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | yes | short message |
| `detail` | string |   | second line (optional) |

### show_panel

Show an IDE panel: problems, output, terminal, tests, test-results, explorer, git, search.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | panel to show. One of: `problems`, `output`, `terminal`, `tests`, `test-results`, `explorer`, `git`, `search` |

### reveal_in_explorer

Show a file or folder in the explorer tree (does not open it).

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | file or folder path |

### list_actions

Find IDE commands (the command palette) for execute_action. Returns id, title, category and gate (auto runs at once, confirm asks the user). Every query word must match the id or title.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string |   | words to match, e.g. "fold" or "git stage"; empty lists all |

### execute_action

Run an IDE command (command palette) by id; find ids with list_actions. Safe commands run at once, others ask the user. Commands act on the active file / cursor.

**Gate:** per action: see Palette actions below

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | command id |

### settings_list

List the IDE settings you may change with settings_set: key, type, current value, allowed values (all theme ids for theme) and help.

**Gate:** auto

No arguments.

### settings_set

Change one IDE setting (see settings_list) and save it to config.json; it applies at once (theme repaints, tab_size sets the editor's indent). The user confirms first.

**Gate:** confirm (settings)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | string | yes | setting key, e.g. theme, tab_size, word_wrap, icons |
| `value` | string | yes | new value |

### layout_set

Change the IDE layout: sidebar width (columns) and shown / hidden, bottom panel height (rows) and open / closed, zen mode, show the AI panel. Give only what should change; sizes are clamped. The AI panel can not be hidden (this chat lives in it).

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ai_panel` | boolean |   | true shows the AI chat panel; false is refused |
| `panel` | boolean |   | open (true) or close (false) the bottom panel; shells keep running |
| `panel_rows` | integer |   | bottom panel height in rows (at least 5) |
| `sidebar` | boolean |   | show (true) or hide (false) the sidebar |
| `sidebar_width` | integer |   | sidebar width in columns (20..60) |
| `zen` | boolean |   | zen mode: only the editor shows (hides this chat too) |

### get_ide_state

Read the whole IDE state as JSON: focus, sidebar view, bottom panel tabs, terminal tabs, layout sizes, zen, theme, icons, git branch and changed files, LSP clients of the active file, problem counts, debug session, running tests and tasks.

**Gate:** auto

No arguments.

### terminal_send

Type text into the user's VISIBLE integrated terminal (opens the panel and a tab when needed) and press Enter. Use it for interactive or long-running commands the user wants to watch: dev servers, watchers, test runs, REPLs, answering a prompt. Then read the output with terminal_read. For a quick command whose output only you need, use run_command.

**Gate:** confirm (run)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes | text to type, e.g. a shell command |
| `enter` | boolean |   | press Enter after the text (default true) |
| `new_tab` | boolean |   | open a new terminal tab for it |
| `tab` | string |   | terminal tab: its number (1 = first) or name; default the active tab |

### terminal_read

Read the last lines of an integrated terminal tab and whether its shell is idle or running a command. wait_ms (max 30000) first waits until the command is done and the output is quiet — e.g. after terminal_send of a test run.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | integer |   | how many last lines (default 50, max 500) |
| `tab` | string |   | terminal tab: its number (1 = first) or name; default the active tab |
| `wait_ms` | integer |   | wait up to this long for the command to finish (default 0, max 30000) |

### terminal_tabs

Manage the integrated terminal tabs: list (number, name, idle / running), new (open a shell tab), focus (show a tab), close (ends its shell; asks the user).

**Gate:** list, new, focus: auto · close: auto for an idle tab, confirm (always asks) while a command runs

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `list`, `new`, `focus`, `close` |
| `tab` | string |   | tab number or name, for focus / close |

### lsp_hover

Hover information (type, signature, docs) of the symbol at a file position, via the language server.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | integer | yes | 1-based column |
| `line` | integer | yes | 1-based line |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |

### lsp_symbols

Symbols via the language server: with path, the outline of that file (name, kind, line); with query, matching symbols in the whole workspace (name, kind, file:line).

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |   | file path (document symbols) |
| `query` | string |   | symbol name to search in the workspace |

### lsp_rename

Rename the symbol at a file position in the whole workspace via the language server. The user reviews the change as a diff and accepts or rejects each part; the result says what was written.

**Gate:** confirm (review)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | integer | yes | 1-based column |
| `line` | integer | yes | 1-based line |
| `new_name` | string | yes | the new name |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |

### lsp_code_actions

Code actions (quick fixes, refactors) at a file position via the language server. op=list shows them numbered; op=apply runs one by index or title. Changed files are saved unless they had unsaved user edits. op=apply shows the change as a diff for the user to review.

**Gate:** list: auto · apply: confirm (review)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | integer | yes | 1-based column |
| `line` | integer | yes | 1-based line |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |
| `index` | integer |   | apply: 1-based number from the list |
| `op` | string |   | list (default) or apply. One of: `list`, `apply` |
| `title` | string |   | apply: action title (exact, or a unique part of it) |

### git_log

Recent commits, newest first: sha, age, author, subject, refs. Optional path limits it to that file's history; n (default 20, max 100).

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `n` | integer |   | number of commits |
| `path` | string |   | file path (optional) |

### git_blame

Who last changed each line of a file: "lines sha author date subject", runs of lines from one commit grouped. Optional start/end lines (1-based); at most 200 lines per call.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |
| `end` | integer |   | last line |
| `start` | integer |   | first line (default 1) |

### git_unstage

Unstage files (keep their changes in the working tree).

**Gate:** confirm (git)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | array | yes | file paths |

### git_fetch

Fetch from the remotes (updates remote branches; the working tree is not touched).

**Gate:** confirm (git)

No arguments.

### git_hunk

Stage, unstage or discard the one diff hunk that contains line (1-based; for unstage, the line in the staged version). discard reverts it in the working tree and can not be undone; it is refused while the file has unsaved edits in the editor.

**Gate:** stage: confirm (git) · unstage: confirm (git) · discard: confirm (always asks)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | integer | yes | a line inside the hunk |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `stage`, `unstage`, `discard` |
| `path` | string | yes | file path |

### git_stash

Stash: list; push (save tracked changes, optional message, and clean the working tree); apply / pop / drop the entry at index (default 0). push/apply/pop are refused while a file has unsaved edits in the editor; drop can not be undone.

**Gate:** list: auto · push: confirm (git) · pop: confirm (git) · apply: confirm (git) · drop: confirm (always asks)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `list`, `push`, `pop`, `apply`, `drop` |
| `index` | integer |   | apply/pop/drop: stash index (stash@{index}) |
| `message` | string |   | push: stash message |

### tasks_list

List the workspace tasks (.termocode/tasks.json, user commands, auto-detected build/test tasks): label, group (build/test, default), command and the state of the last run.

**Gate:** auto

No arguments.

### tasks_run

Run a task in its own VISIBLE terminal tab (like Tasks: Run Task). Pass label (see tasks_list), or group "build" / "test" for the default task of that group. Returns the run id; read the exit code and output with tasks_status(label, wait_ms).

**Gate:** confirm (run)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | string |   | run the default task of this group instead of a label. One of: `build`, `test` |
| `label` | string |   | task label from tasks_list |

### tasks_status

State of a task run: running or the exit code, and the last output lines. label defaults to the newest run. wait_ms waits until the task ends (bounded).

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string |   | task label; default the newest run |
| `lines` | integer |   | how many last output lines (default 40, max 500) |
| `wait_ms` | integer |   | wait up to this long (ms, max 120000) for the run to end; default 0 (answer at once) |

### tests_run

Run tests with the IDE's test runner (go test, pytest, cargo, jest, vitest); the Testing view shows progress. scope: all, file (path or the open file; a folder runs its tests), cursor (the test at the cursor), failed (rerun the failed ones), name (tests with this name). Then call tests_results(wait_ms).

**Gate:** confirm (run)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scope` | string | yes | which tests. One of: `all`, `file`, `cursor`, `failed`, `name` |
| `name` | string |   | test name for scope name, e.g. TestParse |
| `path` | string |   | file or folder for scope file (default the open file) |

### tests_results

Results of the last test run: pass / fail / skip counts, each failing test with file:line and its message, package (build) errors. wait_ms waits until a running test run ends (bounded). only_failed leaves out the passed and skipped names.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `only_failed` | boolean |   | list only failures |
| `wait_ms` | integer |   | wait up to this long (ms, max 120000) for the run to end; default 0 (answer at once) |

### lsp_servers

Manage the language servers termocode installs (like the manager picker). op list: the language servers for the workspace's languages and their state (installed, on PATH, installing, failed). op install: download and install one (asks the user; runs in the background, the tool waits up to wait_ms, default 60000). op uninstall: remove termocode's copy (always asks). Known: gopls, pyright, pylsp, ts_ls, rust_analyzer, clangd, lua_ls, bashls, taplo.

**Gate:** list: auto · install: confirm (run) · uninstall: confirm (always asks)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `list`, `install`, `uninstall` |
| `all` | boolean |   | list: every language server, not only the workspace's |
| `name` | string |   | install / uninstall: the language server name from list |
| `wait_ms` | integer |   | install: wait up to this long (ms, max 120000; default 60000) |

### dap_adapters

Manage the debug adapters termocode installs (like the manager picker). op list: the debug adapters for the workspace's languages and their state (installed, on PATH, installing, failed). op install: download and install one (asks the user; runs in the background, the tool waits up to wait_ms, default 60000). op uninstall: remove termocode's copy (always asks). Known: dlv, debugpy, js-debug.

**Gate:** list: auto · install: confirm (run) · uninstall: confirm (always asks)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `list`, `install`, `uninstall` |
| `all` | boolean |   | list: every debug adapter, not only the workspace's |
| `name` | string |   | install / uninstall: the debug adapter name from list |
| `wait_ms` | integer |   | install: wait up to this long (ms, max 120000; default 60000) |

### extensions

termocode's Lua extensions (~/.config/termocode/extensions). op list: each extension (loaded or the error), its commands, panels and status items. op run: run an extension command by id (asks). op reload: reload all extensions from disk, e.g. after you edit one (asks). op log: load results and the extension log (errors, termocode.log lines).

**Gate:** list: auto · run: confirm (run) · reload: confirm (run) · log: auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `list`, `run`, `reload`, `log` |
| `id` | string |   | run: the command id from list, e.g. todo-tree.refresh |
| `lines` | integer |   | log: how many last log lines (default 100) |

### workspace_folders

The folders shown in the explorer (multi-root workspace). op list: every folder; the first is the primary one (file tools, git and the terminal work there). op add: show another folder as a new root in the explorer (asks). op remove: take an added folder out again (asks). Opening a different workspace is not possible: it restarts termocode and ends this chat.

**Gate:** list: auto · add: confirm (ide) · remove: confirm (ide) · open: never (refused)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `list`, `add`, `remove`, `open` |
| `path` | string |   | add / remove: folder path (absolute, ~/…, or relative to the workspace root); remove also takes the folder name |

### debug_breakpoint

Breakpoints of the debugger (also used by a running session). op: list; set (path, line, optional condition or log_message — a logpoint prints instead of stopping); remove (path, line); clear (all, or only path). They show in the editor gutter and the Run & Debug view and are saved.

**Gate:** list: auto · set: auto · remove: auto · clear: confirm (ide)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `list`, `set`, `remove`, `clear` |
| `condition` | string |   | set: stop only when this expression is true |
| `line` | integer |   | 1-based line (set, remove) |
| `log_message` | string |   | set: print this message instead of stopping; {expr} is replaced by its value |
| `path` | string |   | file (set: default the open file; clear: only this file) |

### debug_state

The debug session: running or paused, stop reason, thread, top stack frames (file:line, function), the variables of the top frame (depth: child levels, default 1, max 3; capped) and the watch values. Without a session: the last exit code, breakpoints and the debug configurations.

**Gate:** auto

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `depth` | integer |   | child levels under each variable (default 1, max 3) |

### debug_start

Start debugging (Run & Debug). config: a launch configuration by name (.termocode/launch.json or auto-detected; debug_state lists them); or path: debug this file (Go: its package) with a configuration for its language; neither: the selected configuration or the open file. Set breakpoints first. Waits (wait_ms, default 30000) for the first stop and returns the state.

**Gate:** confirm (run)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | string |   | launch configuration name |
| `path` | string |   | file to debug |
| `wait_ms` | integer |   | wait up to this long for the first stop (default 30000, max 120000) |

### debug_control

Control the paused / running debug session: continue, pause, step_over, step_into, step_out, stop, restart. Waits (wait_ms, default 10000) for the next stop or the end and returns the new state.

**Gate:** continue: confirm (run) · pause: confirm (ide) · step_over: confirm (run) · step_into: confirm (run) · step_out: confirm (run) · stop: confirm (ide) · restart: confirm (run)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | what to do. One of: `continue`, `pause`, `step_over`, `step_into`, `step_out`, `stop`, `restart` |
| `wait_ms` | integer |   | wait up to this long for the next stop (default 10000, max 120000) |

### debug_evaluate

Evaluate an expression in the paused program's current frame (like the Debug Console). It can call functions and change the program's state. Returns the value, its type and its first fields.

**Gate:** confirm (run)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expr` | string | yes | expression in the program's language |
